name: Just Brown Noise
subtitle: 25 balances. No time limit.
description:
Open the app. Choose a square. Lock your screen and get some rest.

Find your sound in a simple 5-by-5 grid. Move right for more high frequencies and up for more midrange. The same deep bass stays underneath every choice.

The colors follow the sound: red represents the steady bass, green increases with mids, and blue increases with highs. A checkmark shows your selected balance.

• 25 sound balances with five levels of mids and highs
• Smooth changes without restarting playback
• Remembers your last choice
• Starts automatically when you open the app
• Keeps playing in the background and with the screen locked
• Generates sound on your device, without looping a recording
• Works completely offline, with no timer or time limit
• Simple volume and pause controls
• Lock-screen and Control Center playback controls
• A quiet, dark interface

Free. No accounts. No ads. No subscriptions. No tracking.

Playback continues until you pause or force-quit the app. iOS can still interrupt audio for calls, Siri, or system events; the app resumes when iOS permits.
promotionalText: Find your balance in a 5-by-5 sound grid. More highs to the right, more mids upward, with steady bass throughout. Free, offline, and no time limit.
reviewNotes: No login required. Sound starts on launch. Tap any of 25 grid squares: right adds highs, upward adds mids, and the bass layer stays constant. Build 6 changes mids/highs to equal 6 dB steps between the active levels, with zero muting the added layer. The selection is remembered and changes fade smoothly without restarting playback. Background audio is the core function: lock the screen or switch apps to verify playback continues. Sound is generated locally with no recording loop, timer or network dependency. No data collection, ads or purchases.
ageRatingAnswers: No objectionable content, advertising, messaging, user-generated content, web browsing, gambling, contests, or purchases. External links are limited to the app support and privacy pages.
availability: All 175 countries or regions; iPhone and iPad
